scripts.features:
--[ PLAYER ]--
• StunStick Aura: Automatically attacks the Rake when holding the StunStick.
• No SlowDown: Always Run
• Disable Fall Damage: Disables fall damage.
• Infinite Stamina
• Auto Open Door: Automatically opens the Safe House door on 'E' press.
• Auto Open LootBox: Automatically opens all nearby supply crates.
• Open Safe House Door: A manual button to open the door (useful for mobile players).

--[ VISUALS (ESP) ]--
• Players ESP: Shows the location of all other players, complete with a Health Bar.
• Rake ESP: Shows the Rake's location, complete with a Health Bar.
• Scrap ESP: Shows the location of all scrap items.
• LootBox ESP: Shows the location of all supply crates.
• FlareGun ESP: Shows the location of the Flare Gun if it's on the map.
• Place ESP: Shows important locations like the Power Station, Safe House, Shop, etc.
• Info GUI: Displays a separate, small window with critical game info (Rake's Target, Power Level, Timer).

--[ ENVIRONMENT & FARMING ]--
• Full Bright: Brightens the entire map, no flashlight needed.
• Sell Scraps (Points): A button to sell your scrap at the shop.

--[ MISCELLANEOUS ]--
• Rejoin: Rejoins the current server.
• Server Hop: Finds and joins a different available public server.
• Unlock FPS: Removes the 60 FPS cap for smoother gameplay on high-end PCs.

--[ SETTINGS ]--
• UI Toggle Keybind: Set a hotkey to open/close the GUI. (Default: RightControl)
• Unlock/Lock Mouse: Toggles the mouse between cursor and camera control. (Default: RightShift)

--[ CREDITS ]--
• Skedz Hub
